content: Security research should preserve the repo controls: every API read uses ReadScope after principal authentication and RBAC narrowing; inventory rows must be filtered before aggregation or serialization; query parameters must be validated and escaped before KQL construction; raw payloads and secrets must not cross the API or Foundry prompt boundary. The phase adds sensitive host/software metadata, so test out-of-scope non-disclosure, provider failures, bounded pagination, malformed filters, and no silent empty-on-outage behavior.
